doc.title: Tony Marino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 25, 2025

title: Current gigs and Reverend Bill Carter's band
summary: His present calendar: restaurants, breweries, church gigs with Bill Carter, Deer Head Inn, festivals.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: What gigs – your current calendar, what’s it look like these days?

Well nothing major. I do these little gigs around me here, like little restaurants, breweries, you know, community concerts. I do church gigs with this – not far from me there’s a reverend, he’s originally from New York State, Bill Carter. He has a band and he connects his sermon – he’s a Presbyterian minister – spirituality with jazz. And he’s very

into it. And he writes some beautiful stuff. So we record records and we’re going to Georgia at the end of September. And that’s about it. I mean Deer Head, a festival that they just had in Scranton, the Water Gap Festival is coming up so there’ll be a lot of musicians playing at that. So it’s small community concerts, clubs, restaurant, Deer Head Inn, you know, Lafayette Bar in Easton, you know I’ll be there Friday so you know, I’ve been busy. It’s been a decent summer and I’m happy whenever I get a gig. You know? They’re not always pristine, great gigs. People talk and we’ve got to fight through that but we’re playing together and it feels good that we’re playing you know. And we have good moments playing you know? It’s worth it.
